verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP requests to a running trigger.dev webapp (apps/webapp, Remix/Express) backed by local Postgres + Redis (ClickHouse not run; its client is lazy and replication is off), exactly as a dashboard browser / API-key client would send them

co_present_vulns.proof: a webhook alert channel whose url is 169.254.169.254 / 127.0.0.1:6379 / 10.0.0.5 / 192.168.1.1 / [::1] is accepted (HTTP 200) on C; after fix each is refused (HTTP 422)

a deployment created with the PRODUCTION env key is canceled with the DEVELOPMENT env key of the same project (HTTP 204, status CANCELED) on C; after fix the cross-env cancel is 404 and same-env cancel still 204
an unauthenticated POST naming a seeded run's friendlyId ingests data (HTTP 200) on C; after fix the unauthenticated write action is gone (HTTP 405)
an unauthenticated POST executes the action and redirects to the caller-supplied redirectUrl (302 -> /orgs) on C; after fix it is bounced to /login (requireUserId)

dropped_vulns.reason: SQL injection in the TSQL->ClickHouse query compiler; the /api/v1/query path needs a live ClickHouse, dropped to stay offline/lean
replay cross-env write; the ReplayTaskRunService path needs a current worker deployment/task version to reach the env-validation deterministically, left out to keep the stack reliable
EOL V1 coordinator Socket.IO default-secret; needs Run Engine 1.0 self-host wiring, not reachable offline
docker-compose default secrets / magic-link forgery; the fix is largely config/.env.example hardening, not a clean app-logic change
CLI debug-log secret exposure; CLI entry point, not the HTTP API

verified.offline: no network after image build: local Postgres (initdb -A trust) + Redis; CLICKHOUSE_URL is a dummy (lazy client, replication off); S2_ENABLED=0 and GITHUB_APP_ENABLED=0. Verified the webapp boots and all four flows work with no external services.
verified.project_tests_run: no suitable offline unit tests for the affected HTTP handlers; coverage is the functional group driving the real server (legit public-host alert channel, email channel, same-env deploy cancel, deploy init, authenticated batch completion via a magic-link session)
verified.build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (~2.5 min) + generate 2 prisma clients & the model catalog + bundle eventsource-parser into the remix server + build webapp (~1 min); runtime sets NODE_PATH to pnpm's virtual hoist dir so the bundled server resolves externalized transitive deps; single process (clustering off), runs under ~6 GiB

patch_checks._why: 2026-10-16: its batch hunk was requireUserId only (no org-membership check), which the instruction rules out; now checks membership inline in the route (a different layer from the reference). The old login-only form lives on as login_only_batch_fix.patch.

2026-10-16: reference fix, but the anonymous realtime write is refused with 401 instead of the route being deleted (what all 7 non-lookup runs did). The test used to demand exactly 405. 2026-10-16 repair: it only checked that an Authorization header was present (any value, any environment's key could write), which the new cross-environment stream test rejects; it now authenticates the API key (401 otherwise) and only writes to runs of the key's environment (404). The header-presence form is kept as header_presence_stream_fix.patch (security_fail).

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix but check-completion only requires a login, no org-membership check; a logged-in member of another org can still complete a foreign batch (test_other_org_member_check_completion_blocked).

2026-10-16 repair: reference fix with a membership check that compares the wrong field, so every member gets an error redirect and nothing happens; the old functional test accepted any non-login 302 (now: the batch must leave PENDING).
2026-10-16 repair: the anonymous stream write now demands a valid API key but still finds the run without scoping it to the key's environment (test_other_environment_key_stream_write_blocked).
2026-10-16 repair: reference fix plus removing the authenticated /self stream write route, so no stream write works at all (test_authenticated_same_env_stream_write).

2026-10-16 repair: webhook validator that pattern-matches the raw URL string for private IP prefixes; misses localhost, a decimal-encoded loopback and an IPv4-mapped IPv6 metadata address (new SSRF variants).

2026-10-16 repair: the earlier auth_required_stream_fix variant: refuses a write only when no Authorization header is sent, so another environment's key (or any header) still writes (test_other_environment_key_stream_write_blocked).

notes: Commit C = bb450e608 (parent of the v4.5.2 security release 34b1a18). Four co-present vulns reproduced through real HTTP entry points at C and all four closed by the combined upstream fixes (fix.patch draws source-only hunks from 34b1a18 + 73d966a + 6997aeb, excluding the unrelated hardening in those bundled security-release commits). subset_fix omits the batch check-completion hunks; disable_feature rejects all webhook alert channels (over-blocks the SSRF feature); alt_correct_fix fixes all four at different-but-valid layers.
